lines.en: Lesson 103
The French test
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
How long did the exam last?
How was the exam, Richard?
Not too bad.
I think I passed in English and Mathematics.
lines.zh: 我想我英语和数学都及格了。

lines.en: The questions were very easy.
How about you, Gary?
The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough for me.
lines.zh: 英语和数学试卷对我来说都不够简单。

lines.en: I hope I haven't failed.
I think I failed the French paper.
I could answer sixteen of the questions.
They were very easy.
But I couldn't answer the rest.
lines.zh: 但我回答不了剩下的题。

lines.en: They were too difficult for me.
French tests are awful, aren't they?
lines.zh: 法语考试糟透了，不是吗？

lines.en: I hate them.
I'm sure I've got a low mark.
Oh, cheer up!
Perhaps we didn't do too badly.
lines.zh: 也许我们考得没那么糟。

lines.en: The guy next to me wrote his name at the top of the paper.
lines.zh: 我旁边那个家伙在试卷顶部写了他的名字。

lines.en: Yes?
Then he sat there and looked at it for three hours!
lines.zh: 然后他坐在那里看了三个小时！

lines.en: He didn't write a word!
